item.title: Spanberger limits cooperation between state law enforcement and ICE
item.description: RICHMOND, Va. (WAVY) — Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D) ordered a change this week in the way state law enforcement cooperates with federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Spanberger has directed state police and other state enforcement officers not to assist in administrative immigration operations and deportations.
